title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Inland Letter. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Inland Letter
options.thesis: Setting up is addressing your first letter home to parents.
options.viewport: Pale-blue sheet edge to edge; deep-blue welcome; fields on printed address rules; a stamp box top-right that fills with your initials; batches as ruled lines; Get started pinned at thumb height.
options.risk: Reads nostalgic or form-like if the rules get dense; must stay airy and fast.

raised.raise: State by fill: a filled batch line turns solid; an empty one stays dotted and is marked as skipped.
Flat committed colour: inland blue owns the whole ground, with no grain, gradient or paper texture.
Hierarchy by scale contrast alone: no cards or boxes around fields.
One hairline weight for every printed rule on the sheet.
Every state gets a printed mark: a focus bracket, error text in red ink, and a disabled CTA that lists what is still missing.

options.label: NCERT Textbook
options.thesis: Setup reads like the chapter opener of the book every tutor teaches from.
options.viewport: Teal chapter band with 'Chapter 1 · Setting up'; numbered sections 1.1–1.4 for each field; UPI tip as a marigold 'Note' callout; Get started pinned to the bottom.
options.risk: The most familiar of the set, close to a well-built standard form; can tip into school-book or childish.

options.label: Boarding Pass
options.thesis: Your setup is a pass: labelled segments, tabular figures, one alert colour.
options.viewport: A segmented pass: TUTOR, PHONE, UPI segments, then a tear line and batches as rows; orange appears only on errors.
options.case: Fuses cleanly, and labelled segments read instantly. Loses on audience identification: tutors don't live in airports.
options.risk: A travel costume on a tuition app if the segments get decorative.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: Setup as a vertical score read upward.
options.viewport: Centre staff with fields as symbol blocks.
options.case: Fuses poorly: tutors don't read dance scores, and an upward-reading form fights a one-handed flow.
options.kept: State encoded by fill: dotted empty lines vs solid filled lines.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.thesis: Each field a flat colour lobe.
options.viewport: A green lobe holding the form.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it reads as a children's app, which you ruled out.
options.kept: Flat, unmodulated colour committed across the whole ground.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: The welcome as a giant live specimen.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a design-world artifact with no link to tuition.
options.kept: Hierarchy by scale contrast alone, no boxes.

options.label: High-Density Web
options.thesis: Every field packed into ruled modules.
options.viewport: A tiled grid of small modules.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dense, tiny type defeats one-handed use between classes.
options.kept: A strict, single hairline rule system.

options.label: Centre-Rail Edition
options.thesis: Two columns around a keyed rail.
options.viewport: Twin columns that collapse on a phone.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a scholarly reading form on a one-column setup screen.
options.kept: Every state has a printed mark.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean mobile onboarding form, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Title, stacked rounded inputs, an add-batch link, and a full-width blue button pinned to the bottom.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other app setup by design.
